messages.subject: Project Northwind — indicative term sheet (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley,

Attached is the indicative restructuring term sheet we have negotiated with Sterling at a high level. Headlines: £3.5m new super-senior money (Facility B), Facility A pricing up to 4.25% with a PIK toggle, maturity extended to June 2029, revised covenants (leverage 3.50x stepping to 3.00x, DSCR 1.10x, minimum liquidity £1.5m), and an amendment fee of £285k. It is subject to contract and credit approval.

Happy to walk you through it on a call tomorrow. The economics are firm-ish but there is room on the covenant step-down.

James
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
